queries: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s rate is total known bytes divided by total duration for tracks with known bytes; its track count includes all linked tracks.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type’s rate is the average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates.

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds for its tracks with known bytes and positive duration; track counts include every track of that media type.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's rate is the average of its individual tracks' bytes-per-millisecond rates.

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s rate is the average of its tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates. Tracks with missing bytes or zero milliseconds cannot contribute to that rate, but still count toward its track count.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type’s rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds for tracks with a computable rate.
alternatives.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 THEN t.Bytes END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count * 1.0) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.average_rate;
